question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A speech by an actor at the end of a play
solution:
The correct answer is: **Epilogue**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An **Epilogue **is a speech given by an actor at the end of a play. (किसी नाटक के अंत में किसी अभिनेता द्वारा दिया गया भाषण)

 
 
• **Example**: *The novel's epilogue provided closure to the story, revealing the characters' futures beyond the main narrative.*
